name: Zoku・Kimi ni Naramashi Mono o
original_name: 続・君にならましものを
source:
Today marks the long-awaited White Day.
The guy who promised a "threefold return" back on Valentine's Day...I wonder what he has prepared just for me?
I'll put on my favorite outfit and go meet him.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13495]Novelgame[/url]]
